features.note: Native surveydown question and page syntax is preserved.
The generated native project starts in Surveydown preview mode; switch to database mode only after review.

Terminal return buttons and approved input URL parameters are generated. Automatic timers are omitted in native preview. Verify save-before-return and panel behavior in the target R runtime; native preview buttons can navigate externally when clicked.
Display, skip, and stop rules were translated to native Surveydown helpers and require behavioral review.

The native export does not reproduce browser/Supabase atomic Prolific registration, duplicate isolation or save-before-completion-code behavior. Return buttons alone are not an equivalent panel integration; configure and verify the native target separately.
Assignment was translated to a stored native random draw; fixed-block balance and greedyQ persistence equivalence are not claimed.
Displayed consent is preserved; the event ledger is not.
The withdrawal page is exported, but atomic deletion of answers, local state and assignment is a greedyQ database capability. Implement and verify equivalent native storage deletion before fielding.
